integrity: One analytically proved mathematical claim; exact finite-size arithmetic and numerical tests are supporting diagnostics, not a proof for arbitrary N. Novelty is assessed against specified inspected sources and accessible prior results, not globally certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite one-particle chordless odd cycles \(N\ge5\), fixed strictly positive hopping magnitudes and fixed total magnetic flux, no onsite energy, complete vertex dephasing, and the limit of a short coherent interval at fixed N. Not a uniform-size theorem, a partial-dephasing theorem, a quantum-entropy theorem, or a hardware thermodynamic heat estimate. Experimental source supplies the classicalized-walk setting but not the quantitative entropy law.
title: Antipodal hops dominate irreversibility in monitored magnetic quantum rings
